description: This file defines the implementation of the BinomialDistribution class, which models a binomial probability distribution with methods for probability calculations, statistical measures, and distribution parameters.

classes.name: BinomialDistribution
classes.description: Implementation of the binomial distribution, providing probability mass function, cumulative distribution, and statistical parameters.

methods.name: getNumberOfTrials
methods.description: Returns the total number of trials in the distribution.

methods.name: getProbabilityOfSuccess
methods.description: Returns the probability of success in each trial.

methods.name: probability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of exactly x successes.

methods.name: logProbability
methods.description: Calculates the natural logarithm of the probability of x successes.

methods.name: cumulativeProbability
methods.description: Calculates the probability of at most x successes.

methods.name: getNumericalMean
methods.description: Returns the mean of the distribution.

methods.name: getNumericalVariance
methods.description: Returns the variance of the distribution.

methods.name: getSupportLowerBound
methods.description: Returns the lower bound of the support (0 or number of trials).

methods.name: getSupportUpperBound
methods.description: Returns the upper bound of the support (number of trials or 0).

methods.name: isSupportConnected
methods.description: Indicates whether the support of the distribution is connected (true).
